headline: Things I've only ever said to you at 3am
items: That I'm scared I'm getting this wrong, and you just keep eating
Every plan I have for us, in order, to someone who can't hold a spoon
Sorry about the hiccups, as if they were my fault
That I'd do this all again, which I'd never admit at noon
turn: You won't remember a word. I'll remember all of it.
